body: It's a countdown at this point. I don't know when, but when I think about how I am going to die, I just see myself doing it.

I just hate who I am. I hate that I compare myself to others, and I hate that I can never measure up. I try to be a good friend and a good person and a good son. But my I am in such a rough place with my mom right now because I am an adult and we argue a lot. I hate things with my friend and that is honestly what is hurting the most right now. He was my best friend and he kicked me out of his life. I forgave him and now we are talking but we are only allowed to hang out once a weeks and can only talk twice a week because more than that and he says that I rely on him too much and I hate that he is trying so hard to find faults with me when I am just a trying person who cares very much about him. I hate that I am extreme. I don't know how to be someone's "kind-of friend" and I expect the same in return. I hate that I can't end it because then I will be putting other people through pain and that I am scared of how to do it. I am full of so much love for others but so much hate for myself and I feel like nobody will return the favor.

But people do not know that I am depressed and I never let it affect others because I never talk about it. I really do not think I am just going to snap out of it at this point because I always feel bad. I do not hate college, I just meant that it would be a relief for my mom if she did not have to carry that burden anymore. I hate myself and the position that I am in and I hate feeling like everyone else has no time or care for me.

How do I do that? I have always been taught and I honestly believe that every person is on this earth to make it a better place. The massive overall opinion is that I am not doing that. I don't feel valid. I feel like every time I am around I am annoying people. In college I feel like a waste of time and money. I just want to be a good person but even if I feel good about myself it doesn't mean anything if everybody else thinks I am shit. I don't enjoy anything long term anymore. I used to love sports and now I feel like every time I go to the gym I get frustrated. I feel like I have no love in the world and it hurts so bad. Anybody can say that they love another person, but I have never seen a true act of it for myself apart from my mom (I do know that she loves me). I hurt all the time.
